[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1824 directory indexes John Glasgow, with residence field Lancashire, England. Indexed address: 7 Pool street. The listings repeat 7 Pool Street. One copy also indexes Lloyd Street and a broad region list; the entries support the same Pool Street subject.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/8290149 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1824, record 3145/8290149].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/8313778 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1824, record 3145/8313778].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/8844829 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1825, record 3145/8844829].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/15580922 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1828, record 3145/15580922].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/15603441 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1828, record 3145/15603441].</ref>

== Biography ==
The 1852 directory indexes John Glasgow, with residence field Manchester, Lancashire, England. Indexed address: Union Foundry. The Union Foundry and the bolt, lathe and tool trade support a common Manchester directory subject. Earlier same-name Lancashire listings remain separate.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/2931912 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1852, record 3145/2931912].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/2939570 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1852, record 3145/2939570].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/2955309 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1852, record 3145/2955309].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/6251043 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: John Glasgow, 1855, record 3145/6251043].</ref>

== Biography ==
The 1868 directory indexes David Glasgow, with residence field Birmingham, Warwickshire, England. Indexed address: 228 Lady wood lane. The entries give number 228 at a Ladywood address in Birmingham.
